summary: A labelled progress meter, in four colors, with an optional icon, description and card shadow.

props.name: min
props.description: Defaults to Base UI's own Meter minimum (0).

props.name: max
props.description: Defaults to Base UI's own Meter maximum (100).

props.name: label
props.description: Text above the track, correctly wired to it via Base UI's own Meter.Label.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the label. Only shown alongside `icon` - without one there is no header block for it to sit in.

props.name: icon
props.description: A leading avatar. Setting this switches the header to a grouped icon+label+description block & moves the value display below the track instead of beside the label.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Wraps the meter in a padded card. `none` renders it bare, with no card at all.

props.name: animate
props.description: The indicator's width transition as `value` changes.

props.name: className
props.description: Appended to the root's classes, so any Yumma CSS utility you pass wins.
